name: createCollectionResponse
description:
Creates a request response in a collection. For a complete list of request body properties, refer to the **Response** entry in the [Postman Collection Format documentation](https://schema.postman.com/collection/json/v2.1.0/draft-07/docs/index.html).

**Note:**

It is recommended that you pass the \`name\` property in the request body. If you do not, the system uses a null value. As a result, this creates a response with a blank name.

dataMode.description: The associated request body's data mode.

language.description: The raw mode data's language type.

dataOptions.description: Additional configurations and options set for the request body's various data modes.

key.description: The header's key, such as `Content-Type` or `X-Custom-Header`.

name.description: The response's name. It is recommended that you pass the `name` property in the request body. If you do not, the system uses a null value. As a result, this creates a response with a blank name.

rawModeData.description: The associated request body's raw mode data.

requestObject.description: A JSON-stringified representation of the associated request.

responseCode.description: The response's HTTP response code information.

code.description: The response's HTTP response status code.

name.description: The name of the status code.

text.description: The raw text of the response body.

time.description: The time taken by the request to complete, in milliseconds.
